description: Land Title Settlement Department - Vilagedara, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420508
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
